No unanswered FAQ question was spotted (all six structured questions carry answers) and there are no open-house listings on the page to conflict.

The address-check tool's coverage is narrower than the guide's scope: The guide is BC-wide, but its own ALR address-check tool covers Surrey, Langley (City and Township) and Abbotsford addresses per its text — a farm outside those municipalities gets no check from the tool and needs the ALC/local-government route directly.
